videos.title: Rockstar's Union Vote Result Is In — And It Wasn't Close 🗳️ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Rockstar's UK staff voted about 75% against recognizing the IWGB union (1,163 no to 381 yes, 93% turnout) in a ballot that ran Nov 12–26 during GTA 6's launch. The union says it will keep organizing.

Sources: Kotaku, Yahoo News, Gamespark, Gaming Route

videos.title: Take-Two Just Wiped Out 3,007 GTA 6 PC Ports 💻 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
On Nov 24, GitHub removed 3,007 repositories after a Take-Two DMCA notice targeting an unofficial GTA 6 PC recompilation, which the notice says used stolen Xbox build files. GTA 6 is still only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with no official PC date.

Sources: Tom's Hardware, DualShockers, TweakTown, Make Tech Easier, Notebookcheck

videos.title: Avoid This GTA 6 Chapter 3 Softlock ⚠️ #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
Players report that finishing the Missing Persons side mission in Port Gellhorn can leave Jason greyed out and block the story. The Nov 23 patch didn't mention it and Rockstar hasn't confirmed it, so make a manual save first.

Sources: GamingBible, IBTimes UK, Game Rant
